s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic facial swelling and skin lesions with a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Violaceous swelling with telangiectasia and necrosis on the face
Pain on palpation without fever or chills
Histopathological findings of atypical cells in dilated vessels
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 60s
3-month history of pain, swelling, and erythema on the face
History of left breast carcinoma diagnosed eleven years earlier
Left breast carcinoma was treated with mastectomy, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy
Left supraclavicular lymph nodes metastasis occurred seven years after initial diagnosis
Metastasis was treated with surgical excision
Current symptoms include pain on palpation without fever or chills
Histopathological examination showed hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and dilated vessels in the dermis
Immunohistochemical examination showed epithelial cells in dilated vessels positive for CD31 and atypical cells positive for GATA3

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic facial swelling and skin lesions with a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Violaceous swelling with telangiectasia and necrosis on the face
Pain on palpation without fever or chills
Histopathological findings of atypical cells in dilated vessels
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 60s
3-month history of pain, swelling, and erythema on the face
History of left breast carcinoma diagnosed eleven years earlier
Left breast carcinoma was treated with mastectomy, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy
Left supraclavicular lymph nodes metastasis occurred seven years after initial diagnosis
Metastasis was treated with surgical excision
Current symptoms include pain on palpation without fever or chills
Histopathological examination showed hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and dilated vessels in the dermis
Immunohistochemical examination showed epithelial cells in dilated vessels positive for CD31 and atypical cells positive for GATA3

raw.rationale: The patient's history of radiation therapy for breast carcinoma and the presence of atypical cells in dilated vessels with positive GATA3 staining are consistent with postradiation angiosarcoma.

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific history of radiation therapy

rejected.label: Lymphangiosarcoma
rejected.why: No evidence of lymphatic vessel involvement

rejected.label: Metastatic carcinoma
rejected.why: Atypical cells were positive for GATA3, which is more specific to breast tissue, but the histopathological and immunohistochemical findings are more consistent with a vascular tumor

rejected.label: Atypical vascular lesion
rejected.why: The presence of highly atypical cells and the patient's history of radiation therapy suggest a more specific diagnosis of postradiation angiosarcoma
